title: Robust Tangent Space Estimation via Laplacian Eigenvector Gradient Orthogonalization
abstract: arXiv:2510.02308v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating the tangent spaces of a data manifold is a fundamental problem in geometric data analysis. The standard approach, Local Principal Component Analysis (LPCA), struggles in high-noise settings due to a critical trade-off in choosing the neighborhood size. Selecting an optimal size requires prior knowledge of the geometric and noise characteristics of the data that are often unavailable. In this paper, we propose a spectral method, Laplacian Eigenvector Gradient Orthogonalization (LEGO), that utilizes the global structure of the data to guide local tangent space estimation. Instead of relying solely on local neighborhoods, LEGO estimates the tangent space at each data point by orthogonalizing the gradients of low-frequency eigenvectors of the graph Laplacian. translated_title: 基于拉普拉斯特征向量梯度正交化的鲁棒切空间估计
translated_abstract: 估计数据流形的切空间是几何数据分析中的一个基本问题。标准方法——局部主成分分析（LPCA）——由于在邻域大小选择上存在关键权衡，在高噪声环境下表现不佳。选择最优邻域大小需要事先了解数据的几何和噪声特性，而这些信息往往难以获得。本文提出了一种谱方法——拉普拉斯特征向量梯度正交化（LEGO），利用数据的全局结构来指导局部切空间估计。LEGO不再仅仅依赖局部邻域，而是通过对图拉普拉斯算子的低频特征向量的梯度进行正交化，来估计每个数据点处的切空间。我们为该方法提供了两个理论证明：首先，对流形管状邻域的微分几何分析表明，低频特征向量的梯度……
tldr: 提出了一种名为LEGO的谱方法，通过正交化图拉普拉斯低频特征向量的梯度，利用数据的全局结构来鲁棒地估计流形切空间，克服了局部PCA在高噪声环境下邻域大小选择的两难困境。
en_tdlr: LEGO is a spectral method that robustly estimates manifold tangent spaces by orthogonalizing gradients of low-frequency graph Laplacian eigenvectors, leveraging global data structure to overcome the neighborhood-size trade-off that plagues local PCA in high-noise settings.
